teacherNotes.title: Core Words
teacherNotes.content: bed, sofa, chair, table, wardrobe, lamp, shelf, TV, door, window, on, under, next to

elements.content: Core Active Vocabulary (10-20 items):
bed, sofa, chair, table, wardrobe, lamp, shelf, TV, door, window, on, under, next to
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• Where is the sofa? (asking item position)
• The sofa is next to the window (stating location)
• The lamp is on the table (specifying placement)
• There is a wardrobe behind the bed (describing room interior)
Pronunciation Focus:
Pronunciation of prepositions: 'under' /ˈʌn.də/, 'behind' /bɪˈhaɪnd/.

teacherNotes.title: Grammar Function
teacherNotes.content: Prepositions of Place ('on', 'under', 'next to', 'in front of', 'behind', 'between')

elements.content: Grammar System & Functional Framing:
Prepositions of Place ('on', 'under', 'next to', 'in front of', 'behind', 'between')
Controlled Practice:
The book is on top of the desk. Where is the book?
Reading Script & Dialogue:

A: Where is your computer?
B: It is on the desk in my bedroom.
A: Is there a TV in your bedroom?
B: No, the TV is in the living room, next to the sofa.
Listening Comprehension:
Listen to a person describing their living room layout and draw the furniture in correct positions.

teacherNotes.title: Speaking Aim (~70%)
